root_cause: Dashboard v2 default range used the all-model common window, so the short SOXLBacktest reference baseline clipped the main chart comparison to 2026-06-09 even though market data reached 2026-06-12 and actor replay reached 2026-06-11.
The default chart model followed the reference baseline ordering and could select noisy/non-primary models, making the position and NAV panes look misleading.
The bottom panels rendered a full comparison table and verbose source list, which made the page hard to scan.
changes: Default visible range now starts at the latest market year's first available trading day and ends at latest_market_date.
Default chart model now prefers a non-reference replay actor; generated v2 defaults are SOXLBacktest reference baseline plus balanced_rule_residual_v22.
Model Snapshot uses compact cards, Data Status uses a short status strip, and mismatch rows are capped to the most recent 12.
